text:
maria: BrightGrid dispute on INV-2026-7710. They say a $6,842.75 overage appeared after an APAC failover on 2026-09-14.
jonas: I pulled the meter log. Looks like Meterly delivered the same batch twice with different batch_ids due to a garbage-collection bug in their queueing system. The extra units map to ~190k tokens across embedding and burst meters.
carla-finance: summary numbers please. BrightGrid is asking for a full reversal + SLA credit.
jonas: quick calc: duplicate units = 190,124 tokens. Our combined per-token effective rate for that customer's reserved profile is $0.036/unit -> $6,844.46 pre-tax. Invoice overage shows $6,842.75 (rounding/tax differences).
sam: Meterly opened ticket MTR-4450 and acknowledged duplicate batch delivery; they suggest issuing a provisional credit and they'll reimburse. They also note their portal will post a vendor credit note.
maria: customer is requesting the credit posted this week to complete their month-end close. Can we do provisional credit but mark it vendor-recoverable?
carla-finance: yes. Proposed action: (1) post provisional credit $6,842.75 now; (2) tag accounting as VendorRecovery/MTR-4450; (3) include a 21-day vendor recovery window because of cross-border tax withholdings.
jonas: note: Meterly is based in APAC; their reimbursement may be subject to withholding taxes. Finance should coordinate with Tax on treatment.
carla-finance: good call. I'll loop in tax and use GL 6102 for provisional. Also we'll add memo: "Provisional vendor-recoverable credit for duplicated meter events; vendor ticket MTR-4450."
meterly-support: we've deployed a fix. Will provide signed admission and APAC credit note within 7 business days.
maria: draft customer message: "Hi BrightGrid 12; we identified duplicated meter events from our third-party meter vendor during your failover window. We've issued a provisional credit of $6,842.75 to your account while we collect vendor reimbursement. We will reconcile within 21 days and notify you of the outcome."
carla-finance: small ask: include a short line about taxes: "final settlement may reflect adjustments for cross-border tax treatment if applicable."
maria: added. Sending now to customer.
sam: vendor updated ticket: MTR-4450 -> vendor acceptance and commitment to reimburse. Provided provisional document link.
carla-finance: approvals: @carla-finance, @jonas, @sam react :thumbsup: to authorize provisional credit and GL entry.
carla-finance: (reacts) :thumbsup:
jonas: (reacts) :thumbsup:
sam: (reacts) :thumbsup:
maria: posted customer note and attached reconciliation CSV. permalink: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01FINANCE/p1876543210001234
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-7710 status updated -> ADJUSTED (credit $6,842.75) / VendorTicket: MTR-4450
carla-finance: follow-ups: tax team for withholding guidance, receipt of vendor credit note, final AR recon. Leaving thread open until vendor reimbursement posts or 21 days elapse.
